purpose: Historical monthly industry availability using R72 source selection and each snapshot prior-month membership
scope: SW2021 L1/L2/L3 frozen monthly panel catalogue at each date, separate levels
membership: date.to_period(M)-1, including parent-L1 identity at same month; no September survivor selection
denominator: resolved members plus unresolved maximum, retain all catalogue rows; financial excluded not interpreted as mechanism failure
outputs: member provenance and industry coverage plus joint capex/OCF/profit direction counts when known; no future labels
validation: September must reproduce R70 common sample and direction counts; earlier snapshots checked against exact source and member month
limits: Historical proxy, six snapshots not six independent economic periods; source availability not causal or investment validation
